violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: 1) OBSERVED COMMERCIAL DEEP DISH PIZZA (BOTH PEPPERONI AND CHEESE) AND COMMERCIAL CHICKEN PATTIES AT TEMPERATURES OF 124f-126f USING A CALIBRATED FOOD THERMOMETER.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. EHS INSTRUCTED THE STAFF AND MANAGER TO REHEAT THE FOODS TO 165F. EHS ALSO RECOMMENDED THAT THE FOODS BE PUT DIRECTLY INTO THE HOT WELLS AND NOT LAID ON TOP USING SHEET PANS. MANAGER REHEATED THE FOODS TO 165F. ENSURE CONTINUED CORRECTION BEFORE THE NEXT INSPECTION.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: 1) OBSERVED ICEBERG LETTUCE MIX AND COMMERCIAL STRING CHEESE ON THE SERVICE LINES AT 54F.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. EHS INSTRUCTED STAFF AND THE MANAGER TO RAPIDLY CHILL THE FOODS BACK DOWN TO 41F USING THE WALK-IN FREEZER. EHS ALSO RECOMMENDED THAT THE ICEBERG LETTUCE MIX AND STRING CHEESE (OR YOGURT PARFAITS) BE STORED DIRECTLY ON TOP OF THE COLD PLATE AT THE SERVICE LINES. DO NOT LINE THE COLD PLATES WITH BLACK PLASTIC TRAYS. ENSURE CONTINUED CORRECTION BEFORE THE NEXT INSPECTION. LANGSTON HUGHES INTERMEDIATE SCHOOL (Inspection Date: 04/17/2026) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Jewelry
violations.observation: Observed food employees wearing watches and/or bracelets.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees shall limit their jewelry to a plain wedding ring while preparing food. Food employees may not wear bracelets, watches, etc. because they can inhibit proper hand washing. EHS INSTRUCTED THE STAFF MEMBERS TO REMOVE THE WATCHES AND BRACELETS. ENSURE CONTINUED CORRECTION BEFORE THE NEXT INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Garbage and refuse properly disposed, facilities maintained

violations.title: Outside Receptacle, Tight Fitting Lids
violations.observation: Observed the outdoor dumpsters and/or recycling bin(s) with the doors open.
violations.corrective_action: Receptacles and waste handling units for refuse, recyclables, and returnables shall be kept covered with tight fitting lids or doors if kept outside the food establishment. EHS INSTRUCTED THE CUSTODIAL STAFF TO KEEP ALL LIDS AND/OR DOORS CLOSED UNLESS ACTIVELY DISPOSING OF TRASH AND/OR RECYCLING. ENSURE CONTINUED CORRECTION BEFORE THE NEXT INSPECTION.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: French fries observed in warming cabinets at ~120F.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. Food was reheated to ~170 for hot holding.
